chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from Mansur ibn al-Abbas, from Ali ibn Asbat, raising it to Salman, who said:

When Allah, Mighty and Majestic, intends the destruction of a servant, He removes bashfulness from him. So when bashfulness is removed from him, you will not meet him except as deceitful and causing deception. So when he is deceitful and causing deception, trustworthiness is removed from him. So when trustworthiness is removed from him, you will not meet him except as rough and harsh. So when he is rough and harsh, the noose of faith is removed from him. So when the noose of faith is removed from him, you will not meet him except as a Satan, accursed.

key_terms.رِبْقَةُ الْإِيمَانِ: the noose or bond of faith

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual progression that leads to the destruction of a servant of Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details a cascading spiritual decay where the loss of *hayā'* (bashfulness/modesty) triggers a sequence of moral failures, culminating in the complete erosion of *imān* (faith). In Shia scholarship, this progression is often viewed as a diagnostic tool for assessing the state of the heart, illustrating how external behavior reflects internal spiritual health. The chain emphasizes that *hayā'* is the foundational virtue; its absence leads to *khiānah* (treachery) and *ghilẓ* (coarseness), ultimately transforming the individual into a 'cursed Satan' archetype.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Ali Bin Asbat, raising it to Salman who said,

‘(Heasws said): ‘Whenever Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Intends to Destroy a servant, Removes the bashfulness from him. So when the bashfulness is Removed from him, you will not meet him except as a deceitful and causing deception. So when he was deceitful and causing deception, the entrustments would be removed from him. So when the entrustments are Removed from him, you will not meet him except as rude and harsh. So when he was rude and harsh, the yoke of Emān is Removed from him, you will not meet him except as a Satanla, accursed’.
en.sarwar: 10. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla ibn Muhammad from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from Ali ibn Asbat in a marfu’ manner from Salman who has said the following:

“When Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, wants to destroy a person He removes bashfulness from him. When bashfulness is removed, you will not find anything in him but deceit and causing deception. When one is deceitful and deceptive, no one trusts him and when he can no longer be trusted you will not find him anything but an intensely harsh tempered one. When one is intensely harsh tempered the harness of belief is removed from him and when the harness of belief is removed from him you will find him to be nothing else but a condemned Satan.”
